notes.title: Laurel's Day Full Game Release September 19th
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569764/8a758e6c73b6aff251b196102326a91cc7089f7e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Laurel's Day became too powerful to just be a side game inside of Dimensional Gates alone. What is happening is we are releasing Laurel's Day September 19th alongside the Dimensional Gates Demo as a full game release. Being inexpensive and at a 40% discount for two weeks from launch date, Laurel's Day is a great way for you to get more information on how Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios makes games. The Dimensional Gate Demo doesn't tie things up and end a game, but Laurel's Day will allow you to see how powerful the endings Not Allowed to Die Gaming Studios makes.   [/p][p][/p][p]I will also be including Laurel's Day inside of the Dimensional Gates Collector's Edition as well...[/p]
